name: knurled
title: Knurled
note: A knurled knob in an enamelled track. Two marks are pressed into the floor, which turns orange when on.

name: soft
title: Soft
note: One material throughout: the track is pressed into the sheet and the knob swells out of it, told apart by light alone. A small lamp shows when it is on.

name: rocker
title: Rocker
note: A rocker plate in a dark panel. It pivots on its middle: the pressed side sinks into the panel, the other side lifts, and the bar on the pressed side lights.

name: slider
title: Slider
note: A block with three finger ridges sliding in a dark slot. Pushed across, it uncovers a green lamp at the far end.

name: ball
title: Ball
note: A glazed white ball rolling in a rounded groove. The groove fills with blue as the ball crosses to the on side.

name: dish
title: Dish
note: The reverse of the others: the bar stands up from the sheet and the thumb rest is a shallow dish sliding in a channel in its top. One clay; the dish turns cream when on.
